articles.summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN) today announced the appointment of Ravi Simhambhatla as Chief Technology and AI Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Mr. Simhambhatla will lead the Company’s technology, data science, and AI agenda. Ravi Simhambhatla joins AutoNation as Chief Technology and AI Officer "Over decades, we have built a portfolio of brands, physical infrastructure, and scale that have delivered consistently strong returns for our shareholders, and that would be nearly impossible to replicate today," said Mike Manley, Chief Executive Officer of AutoNation. "Technology, data science, and the intelligent use of AI give us the opportunity to get significantly more from that foundation: to raise the returns on our capital and extend our reach well beyond traditional geographic boundaries. That's why I'm delighted to welcome Ravi. From building an airline's systems from scratch to leading global technology at Avis Budget Group, he has turned technology into a competitive advantage at
articles.title: AutoNation Appoints Ravi Simhambhatla Chief Technology and AI Officer
